title: Two blocs: the world after 1945
goal: I can explain how the world split into two blocs after 1945, and describe containment and the arms race.
grammar: relative clauses with que and quien

items: I can say which superpowers led the two blocs.
I can describe the policy of containment.
I can talk about the arms race.
I can add information about people and things with *que* and *quien*.
I can add information about the two blocs with *que* and *quien*.
I can say which superpowers led the two blocs after 1945.
I can describe the policy of containment.
I can talk about the arms race and the atomic bomb.
I can say why Latin America became part of the Cold War stage.
